name: vllm-nvfp4-marlin
notes: DGX :8082 parity (same flags as natlang-qwen36-nvfp4-server) except memory utilisation 0.90 and 16k batched tokens: the GB10 runs 0.45 beside training; a sandbox owns its GPU. Marlin W4A16 MoE is the path known to work on sm_120 (vLLM SM120 NVFP4 report).

name: vllm-nvfp4-native
notes: native FP4 MoE (vLLM's own backend choice on sm_120: FlashInfer/CUTLASS block-scaled W4A4). Faster than Marlin at high concurrency if it works; check outputs against the Marlin run (garbage outputs were reported on older FlashInfer).

name: vllm-fp8
notes: W8A8 FP8 checkpoint (~36 GB, fits with ~45 GB of KV). Needs Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 in the bundle or hub egress (HF_HUB_OFFLINE unset). Higher quality than NVFP4; on sm_120 FP8 MoE runs Triton (CUTLASS 4.6 sm_120 grouped FP8 may not be integrated yet).

name: vllm-nvfp4-marlin-mtp2
notes: the Marlin configuration plus the model's own multi-token-prediction head as drafter (2 tokens). Helps low concurrency (single-stream latency); at 128+ concurrent requests it usually costs throughput. Method name per vLLM docs for Qwen3.5-family MTP (unverified on v0.31; a startup failure is recorded, not fatal). The NVFP4 export must carry the MTP weights.
